name: 压力知觉量表
instructions: 请回想过去一个月内，你对以下情况的感受和想法。请根据实际发生的频率，选择最符合的一项。
instructionsEn: Please think back over the past month about how you felt and thought about the following situations. Choose the option that best matches how often it actually happened.
license: Cohen 等编制，可免费用于研究与非商业用途，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常因为一些没有预料到的事情而感到心烦意乱？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you been upset because of something that happened unexpectedly?

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常觉得自己无法控制生活中重要的事情？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you felt unable to control important things in your life?

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常感到紧张不安、有压力？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you felt nervous and stressed?

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常对自己处理个人问题的能力感到有信心？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you felt confident in your ability to handle your personal problems?

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常觉得事情正按自己的意愿发展？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you felt that things were going your way?

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常发现自己无法应付所有该做的事情？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you found that you could not cope with all the things you had to do?

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常能够控制生活中的烦心事？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you been able to control irritations in your life?

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常觉得自己能游刃有余地处理好各种事情？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you felt that you were on top of things?

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常因为一些自己无法控制的事情而生气？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you been angered because of things that were outside of your control?

items.text: 过去一个月里，你是否经常觉得困难堆积如山，自己无法克服？
items.textEn: In the last month, how often have you felt that difficulties were piling up so high that you could not overcome them?

totalBands.description: 当前感知到的压力水平较低。
存在中等程度的压力感，建议关注并适时自我调节。
感知到的压力水平较高，长期高压力可能影响身心健康，建议寻求支持或专业帮助。
